logbook.text: You managed to escape the prison station, together with the Axiom. As the next step, you are to be introduced to someone called 'the Maestro', who is interested in offering you a job.

logbook.title: Contraband delivered

mission_offers.name: Holy Order vs. Paranid
mission_offers.description: The so-called Godrealm of the Paranid name us heretics, but it is they who betray our beliefs and our principles. They are weak, and they must be crushed. It is simply a matter of time before we know victory against them, but we still seek brave and strong warriors to join our fight and share in our righteous glory! Praise be to the true Pontifex!

mission_offers.name: Argon Vs. Xenon
mission_offers.description: Due to our close proximity to Xenon space, we are looking for volunteers help secure our borders as well as repel any Xenon incursions. We have a wide variety of tasks to assign so whatever your skills do not hesitate to sign up!

mission_offers.name: Argon Vs. Holy Order
mission_offers.description: The Holy Order, an offshoot faction of the Paranid Empire, continues to test our borders and those of our allies. These 'heretics', as described by the Godrealm of the Paranid, are being pushed from all sides with no allies to speak of. We are looking for trusted friends of the Argon Federation to help keep them in check.

mission_offers.name: Holy Order vs. Argon
mission_offers.description: In its infinite stupidity, the Argon Federation has sided with the weak and pathetic Godrealm of the Paranid and have joined in their fight against us. The fools have made a grave error in judgement. We seek a brave and strong warrior to join our fight and show those that stand against us that they will know no victory.

mission_offers.name: The Righteous Paranid Empire Vs. the 'Heretical Order'
mission_offers.description: Our burning holy light continues to grow with each passing day. We find ourselves tested with our own brethren being led astray by their own hubris. While we hope to bring a number of them back into the fold, their 'governing' leaders wish them to continue down this path of blasphemy and destruction. We seek to uplift those willing to aid the Paranid Empire, so that they can bathe in its glory. Should you have faith in your abilities, we are willing to listen to your pleas.

mission_offers.name: Split Vs. Argon
mission_offers.description: Wretched Argon Federation refuse to back down. Their insistence on opposing subjugation can only be met with open war. Split are looking for capable individuals to aid with Argon annihilation. Reinforce borders. Lead attacks on their turf. Split can offer a variety of duties for you to tend to!

mission_offers.name: Terran Vs. Xenon
mission_offers.description: The Community of Planets' irresponsible inaction in containing the Xenon has once again demonstrated that Sol can only be safe if the Terran Protectorate takes a proactive stance. We request that any able citizen of the Sol system reports to their designated representative. Furthermore, we also welcome any individual from outside Sol, as long as they prove to be capable.

mission_offers.name: Guerilla Research and Development
mission_offers.description: Oh hey, you![\012]You look like someone resourceful, would you mind helping me out? Until recently, I was employed as head of Research and Development at Jinko-Tekina Technologies, the industry-leading ship manufacturing company. While working on their ship designs, in my free time and using company resources, I also pioneered a new kind of experimental on-board computer: a sentient machine, able not only to interpret information, but also to predict it, and to learn. A computer able to feel empathy and appreciate arts, to be self-aware and sapient.[\012]Think of the effects such a computer, with a personality, could have on the crew, too. No more need for dangerous missions to be manned. Lone pilots would have someone they could talk to on those long delivery runs... It would have changed everything. But alas, my superiors grew restless when progress temporarily stalled on my other projects, and things escalated when they became aware of what I was pursuing. They didn't believe I could actually pull it off, but still, they didn't want their brand to be associated with A.I. Research, and some board members even became scared, and voiced ethical concerns. How very narrow-minded of them. I was this close to success, but they fired me, and in doing so cut off all of my funding.[\012]However, I was able to smuggle out most of my research and various company resources with me when I left. Now, stranded on this wharf, I intend to finish what I started, and change the universe forever, for the better.[\012]I just need some technical parts to finish my work, but I can't acquire them myself for fear of leaving my project unguarded. They are fairly common processing units, you should be able to find them attached to... well, Xenon ships. If you bring me what I need, not only will I pay you for your work, but you'll be remembered in history as the person who made it all happen!

missions.name: Historical Logs
missions.description: I have an insatiable appetite for the history of our civilisations, especially that of the Argon-Xenon conflict. Should you find any historical accounts, I would be very happy to read them.

missions.name: High-Profile Military Target(s)
missions.description: A number of enemy ships have been spotted recently that give us cause for concern. The reports have all been from civilians, and so don't give us enough information to track down the ships, but we believe we have accurate descriptions of what the ships look like. We are looking for someone willing to remove these ships should you come accross them on your travels.[\012]Ship Specifications:[\012]Xenon N[\012][\012]Note: the target signature has been loaded into your ship computer. While this mission is active, your ship computer will notify you whenever matches are detected in the vicinity. At the start of this mission, intelligence reported sightings of matching targets in the following location: Tharka's Cascade XV.

missions.name: Second Assistant
missions.description: The Segarian chief scientist has requested further assistance from you. To help the Segarians with Project Genesis, you are asked to report to an independent scientist by the name of Kuromanckami.

missions.name: Laser Tower Deployment
missions.description: We seek a contractor to deploy a number of laser towers around a potentially vulnerable station. While laser towers are commonly used as a deterrent, they have in the past turned the tide of battles when used effectively. In these uncertain times, we deem it fit to increase our military presence wherever possible.[\012][\012]Note: Procuring the required deployables is your responsibility. You can equip your ship with deployables on Wharfs, Shipyards and Equipment Docks. Their cost will be reimbursed through the mission reward after completion.

missions.name: Epilogue: Consequences
missions.description: You went for it! You stole the distribution module blueprints from right under the Twins' noses! With this module, and the knowledge of where you can procure more Protectyon, you can build up a rival trade empire in Avarice, and lower the prices significantly should you so choose. But of course the Northriver Company will not sit idly by. It appears they have put a price on your head, and the Syndicate is looking to collect. Though, if you handle this right, you can surely get them off your back again.
missions.reward_text: Get the Vigor Syndicate off your back

missions.name: A Demonstration of Power
missions.description: The Syndicate will not let up until you show them that you are a real danger if you are provoked to attack. Destroying a station crucial to their operations should do the trick!

missions.name: Reaching Out to the Enemy
missions.description: Show the Syndicate that the Northriver Company are not the only ones around these parts with deep pockets, and they might be persuaded to back off. Buying their indifference will probably not be cheap, though.

missions.name: Teladi Trade Guild
missions.description: The well known and respected Teladi Trade Guild is always looking for skilled and proven traders to bolster our ranks. You have caught our attention and we wish to extend this invitation to you. If you are interested, please meet with me.

missions.name: The Queen's Herald
missions.description: The Queendom of Boron seeks to re-establish diplomatic relations with various governments in the Jump gate network. You are tasked with reaching out to various parties on the Queendom's behalf.

missions.name: Hatikvah Arms Delivery
missions.description: The Queendom of Boron seeks to provide Boron combat ships to the Hatikvah Free League. Your task is to provide a first fleet, while the Queendom negotiates further shipments.[\012][\012]3x Mako[\012] Equipment[\012]   BOR S All-round Engine Mk1[\012]   BOR S Phase Gun Mk1[\012]   BOR S Phase Gun Mk1[\012]   BOR S Shield Generator Mk1[\012]   S Combat Thrusters Mk1[\012]

missions.name: Riptide Waters
missions.description: The Queendom of Boron seeks to help the Riptide Rakers of Avarice with water deliveries. You are tasked with delivering the first shipment. Be wary of potential adversaries.

missions.name: Diplomatic Outpost in Teladi Space
missions.description: The Queendom of Boron seeks to establish a Diplomatic Outpost in order to stay in contact with the Teladi Company. You are tasked with initiating, overseeing and completing the construction of the new Boron station.[\012][\012]Destination: Eighteen Billion (at specified location)[\012]Minimum plot size: 5 x 3 x 4 km[\012]Required constructs: 1 x Boron 4M14S Luxury Dock Area, 1 x Boron 1-Dock Pier, 1 x Boron S Container Storage, 1 x Boron S Oasis, 1 x Boron Disc Defence Platform, 6 x Shield Generators

missions.name: A Pirate's Trail
missions.description: Operative! We've recently made a breakthrough in our investigation and are in need of someone who's capable and determined enough to go down a particular rabbit hole. The main objective is to gather information, but judging by our intel, it would be prudent to attempt this task in an agile, yet generously armed military ship. You're about to hunt down a few pirates.

missions.name: Infiltrating Split Politics
missions.description: Dal Busta requested a meeting to share his insights on the Split.

missions.name: Covert Operations
missions.description: As expected, access to the server room is strictly limited. Our agents are already working hard on orchestrating a diversion and getting you access to that room. While they do that, we want you to run operations that will weaken the Argon Federation's position.

missions.name: Operation Draco
missions.description: For some time now, we have been dealing with some rather unsavoury characters outside the Sol system, with the explicit goal of applying pressure on the Argon Federation. Being a thorn in the Argon Federation's side, the Scale Plate Pact is being armed and partially financed by us. We want you to provide a fully supplied ship for them.[\012][\012]1x Minotaur Sentinel[\012] Equipment[\012]   ARG M Combat Engine Mk2[\012]   ARG M Shield Generator Mk2[\012]   M Combat Thrusters Mk2[\012]   ARG M Bolt Turret Mk1[\012]   M Pulse Laser Mk2[\012] Ammunition[\012]   20x Laser Tower Mk1[\012]   10x Friend/Foe Mine[\012][\012] Wares[\012]   10x Drone Components[\012]   100x Missile Components[\012]   20x Weapon Components[\012][\012]The Minotaur Sentinel can be ordered from the Antigone Republic wharf.

missions.name: A Grand Experiment
missions.description: I must speak with you regarding an experiment I have devised. Please come and see me as soon as you can, so that I can explain it in detail.

missions.name: Opportunity of a Lifetime
missions.description: It's come to my ears that you're on good standing with both the False Godrealm and the Heretic Order, as they affectionately call each other. Well, it turns out that by not choosing a side, you might have created the opportunity for both of us to make history! Come and find me at our Headquarters.[\012][\012]- Dal Busta
